# Role reference

The inputs of every role, from its `meta/argument_specs.yml` and `defaults/main.yml`. An input without a default is required. Common variables (`k8s_lab_*`) are described in the [variable contract](../variable-contract.md).

## bootstrap

The transient k3s bootstrap cluster. Creates the bootstrap container with its API published on the host, installs and starts k3s once, and writes bootstrap.kubeconfig on host and runner. Does nothing when the management cluster is self-hosted.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_project_name` | str | required | LXD project every cluster instance lives in. |
| `k8s_lab_bootstrap_instance_name` | str | required | LXD instance of the bootstrap cluster. |
| `k8s_lab_api_listen_address` | str | required | IPv4 address of the host the published API servers listen on; restrict it on a host with a public address. |
| `k8s_lab_lxd_host_address` | str | required | The host as the runner reaches it (an IPv4 address or a name); the published API servers are on this address. |
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_artifacts_dir` | path | required | Runner directory of the kubeconfigs and handoff.json (0600 files). |
| `k8s_lab_management_state` | str | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state); the role does nothing when it is self_hosted. |
| `bootstrap_project` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_project_name }}` | The LXD project. |
| `bootstrap_instance_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_bootstrap_instance_name }}` | The bootstrap instance. |
| `bootstrap_image_alias` | str | `debian/13/cloud` | Image alias on images.lxd.canonical.com. |
| `bootstrap_api_listen_address` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_api_listen_address }}` | Host address of the proxy device that publishes the k3s API. |
| `bootstrap_api_port` | int | `16443` | Its host port. |
| `bootstrap_api_host` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_lxd_host_address }}` | Address in the kubeconfig, through which host and runner reach the published API. |
| `bootstrap_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Host directory of the k3s binary (bin/) and of the kubeconfig and staging (etc/). |
| `bootstrap_artifacts_dir` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_artifacts_dir }}` | Runner directory of bootstrap.kubeconfig. |
| `bootstrap_wait_timeout` | int | `600` | Seconds to wait for the instance's addresses, and again for a Ready node. |
| `bootstrap_pod_cidrs` | list of str | `["10.42.0.0/16", "fd42:77:42::/56"]` | k3s's Pod networks as [IPv4, IPv6]; apart from the internal network. |
| `bootstrap_service_cidrs` | list of str | `["10.43.0.0/16", "fd42:77:43::/112"]` | k3s's Service networks as [IPv4, IPv6]; apart from the internal network. |
| `bootstrap_cluster_dns` | list of str | `["10.43.0.10", "fd42:77:43::a"]` | k3s's cluster DNS addresses as [IPv4, IPv6], inside the service networks. |
| `bootstrap_enabled` | bool | `true` | Run the role at all. |
| `bootstrap_flow_control_instance` | bool | `true` | The bootstrap container and its address wait. |
| `bootstrap_flow_control_k3s` | bool | `true` | The k3s binary, configuration, unit and node readiness. |
| `bootstrap_flow_control_kubeconfig` | bool | `true` | bootstrap.kubeconfig on host and runner. |

### Entry point `destroy`

Remove the bootstrap cluster once mgmt-1 manages itself. Refuses unless the management state is self_hosted and the bootstrap API holds no Cluster; fails when LXD does not answer. Removes the instance and both kubeconfigs. The main entry point's toggles do not apply.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_project_name` | str | required | LXD project every cluster instance lives in. |
| `k8s_lab_bootstrap_instance_name` | str | required | LXD instance of the bootstrap cluster. |
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_artifacts_dir` | path | required | Runner directory of the kubeconfigs and handoff.json (0600 files). |
| `k8s_lab_management_state` | str | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state); the instance is removed only when it is self_hosted. |
| `bootstrap_project` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_project_name }}` | The LXD project. |
| `bootstrap_instance_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_bootstrap_instance_name }}` | The bootstrap instance. |
| `bootstrap_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Host directory of the k3s binary (bin/) and of the kubeconfig and staging (etc/). |
| `bootstrap_artifacts_dir` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_artifacts_dir }}` | Runner directory of bootstrap.kubeconfig. |

## capn_identity

CAPN's LXD client identity and its Secret. Keeps a client key and self-signed certificate on the host, trusted by LXD for one project only, and the CAPN identity Secret (server-side applied) in each namespace on the API that manages mgmt-1. Rotation replaces the identity in one run without a window of no valid credential.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig_runner` | path | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state) — runner path of the managing API. |
| `k8s_lab_management_state` | str | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state); the role stops with a message without it. |
| `k8s_lab_project_name` | str | required | LXD project every cluster instance lives in. |
| `k8s_lab_infrastructure_secret_name` | str | required | Name of the CAPN identity Secret. |
| `k8s_lab_cluster_namespace` | str | required | Namespace of the Cluster API objects and the CAPN identity Secret. |
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `capn_identity_kubeconfig` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig_runner }}` | Runner path of the kubeconfig the Secrets are applied with. |
| `capn_identity_project` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_project_name }}` | The LXD project the trust entry is restricted to. |
| `capn_identity_secret_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_infrastructure_secret_name }}` | Name of the Secret. |
| `capn_identity_namespaces` | list of str | `["{{ k8s_lab_cluster_namespace }}"]` | Namespaces that get the Secret (where LXCClusters live). |
| `capn_identity_dir` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}/etc/capn_identity` | Host directory of the key (0600) and certificate, the only copy of the key. |
| `capn_identity_validity_days` | int | `1825` | Lifetime of a new certificate; rotate before it ends. |
| `capn_identity_rotate` | bool | `false` | Replace the key and certificate in this run (also happens when the key file is missing). |
| `capn_identity_enabled` | bool | `true` | Run the role at all. |
| `capn_identity_flow_control_certificate` | bool | `true` | Key and certificate. |
| `capn_identity_flow_control_trust` | bool | `true` | The LXD trust entry. |
| `capn_identity_flow_control_secret` | bool | `true` | The Secrets, the check of the new certificate against LXD, and removal of earlier identities. |

README: [ansible/roles/capn_identity](../../ansible/roles/capn_identity/README.md)

## clusterctl

Cluster API providers on the API that manages mgmt-1. Installs the core, kubeadm bootstrap, kubeadm control-plane and CAPN providers at their pins where missing, upgrades those older than their pins, and refuses those that are newer.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig` | path | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state) — the API that manages mgmt-1 now. |
| `k8s_lab_management_state` | str | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state); the role stops with a message without it. |
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_clusterctl_version` | str | required | Cluster API release of clusterctl and of the core and kubeadm providers. |
| `k8s_lab_capn_provider_version` | str | required | Release of the CAPN infrastructure provider. |
| `clusterctl_kubeconfig` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig }}` | Host path of the kubeconfig the providers are managed through. |
| `clusterctl_capi_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_clusterctl_version }}` | Version of the core, kubeadm bootstrap and kubeadm control-plane providers. |
| `clusterctl_capn_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_capn_provider_version }}` | Version of the CAPN infrastructure provider. |
| `clusterctl_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Host directory of the binaries (bin/) and of clusterctl.yaml (etc/clusterctl/). |
| `clusterctl_cert_manager_timeout` | str | `""` | clusterctl's wait for cert-manager, e.g. 25m; empty keeps clusterctl's default. |
| `clusterctl_timeout` | int | `1200` | Seconds an init, an upgrade or the move may take. |
| `clusterctl_enabled` | bool | `true` | Run the role at all. |
| `clusterctl_flow_control_config` | bool | `true` | clusterctl.yaml. |
| `clusterctl_flow_control_providers` | bool | `true` | Provider init and upgrade. |

### Entry point `pivot`

Providers on mgmt-1, then clusterctl move onto it. Ends at once when the management state is self_hosted. Otherwise installs the providers on mgmt-1, moves the Cluster API objects while the Cluster is on the source, and asserts it is on mgmt-1 and gone from the source afterwards. The main entry point's toggles do not apply.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig` | path | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state) — the API that manages mgmt-1 now. |
| `k8s_lab_management_state` | str | required | Published by management_cluster (tasks_from state); the role stops with a message without it. |
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_clusterctl_version` | str | required | Cluster API release of clusterctl and of the core and kubeadm providers. |
| `k8s_lab_capn_provider_version` | str | required | Release of the CAPN infrastructure provider. |
| `clusterctl_kubeconfig` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig }}` | Host path of the kubeconfig the providers are managed through. |
| `clusterctl_capi_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_clusterctl_version }}` | Version of the core, kubeadm bootstrap and kubeadm control-plane providers. |
| `clusterctl_capn_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_capn_provider_version }}` | Version of the CAPN infrastructure provider. |
| `clusterctl_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Host directory of the binaries (bin/) and of clusterctl.yaml (etc/clusterctl/). |
| `clusterctl_cert_manager_timeout` | str | `""` | clusterctl's wait for cert-manager, e.g. 25m; empty keeps clusterctl's default. |
| `clusterctl_timeout` | int | `1200` | Seconds an init, an upgrade or the move may take. |
| `k8s_lab_management_cluster_name` | str | required | Name of the management cluster. |
| `k8s_lab_cluster_namespace` | str | required | Namespace of the Cluster API objects and the CAPN identity Secret. |
| `clusterctl_target_kubeconfig` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}/etc/mgmt.kubeconfig` | Host path of mgmt-1's kubeconfig, the target of the pivot. |
| `clusterctl_cluster_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_management_cluster_name }}` | The Cluster the pivot moves. |
| `clusterctl_cluster_namespace` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_cluster_namespace }}` | Its namespace. |

## host

Host packages, kernel settings, the opt root and the pinned binaries. Prepares an x86_64 Debian 13+ or Ubuntu 22.04+ host for LXD and the Kubernetes nodes inside it. Fails before changing anything when the host has swap on.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_kubectl_version` | str | required | kubectl release, for example v1.37.2. |
| `k8s_lab_kubectl_sha256` | str | required | sha256 of the linux/amd64 kubectl binary of that release (its kubectl.sha256). |
| `k8s_lab_clusterctl_version` | str | required | Cluster API release of clusterctl and of the core and kubeadm providers. |
| `k8s_lab_clusterctl_sha256` | str | required | sha256 of clusterctl-linux-amd64 of that release (upstream publishes none: compute it with sha256sum). |
| `k8s_lab_k3s_version` | str | required | k3s release of the bootstrap cluster, for example v1.37.2+k3s1. |
| `k8s_lab_k3s_sha256` | str | required | sha256 of the amd64 k3s binary of that release (row k3s of its sha256sum-amd64.txt). |
| `host_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Directory the role creates, with bin/ (the binaries) and etc/ (other roles' state). |
| `host_kubectl_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_kubectl_version }}` | kubectl release installed into bin/. |
| `host_kubectl_sha256` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_kubectl_sha256 }}` | Its sha256; a mismatch fails the download. |
| `host_clusterctl_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_clusterctl_version }}` | clusterctl release installed into bin/. |
| `host_clusterctl_sha256` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_clusterctl_sha256 }}` | Its sha256. |
| `host_k3s_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_k3s_version }}` | k3s release installed into bin/ (copied into the bootstrap instance). |
| `host_k3s_sha256` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_k3s_sha256 }}` | Its sha256. |
| `host_enabled` | bool | `true` | Run the role at all. |
| `host_flow_control_preflight` | bool | `true` | OS, architecture and swap checks. |
| `host_flow_control_packages` | bool | `true` | APT packages. |
| `host_flow_control_kernel` | bool | `true` | Kernel modules and sysctls. |
| `host_flow_control_dirs` | bool | `true` | The opt root and its etc/ directory. |
| `host_flow_control_binaries` | bool | `true` | kubectl, clusterctl and k3s in bin/. |

## lxd

LXD and the objects Cluster API nodes run on. Installs LXD from its snap, bridges an uplink to the external network, and creates the image registry, the restricted project, the btrfs pool, the internal network, the API listener and the node profiles. Never restarts an instance. Refuses to re-address a network with instances on it and to move an existing pool to another device.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_project_name` | str | required | LXD project every cluster instance lives in. |
| `lxd_uplink_interface` | str | required | Host interface bridged to the external network (node eth1). It loses its own addresses, so it must not be the interface of the default route. |
| `lxd_storage_source` | str | required | Block device of the btrfs pool, preferably a /dev/disk/by-id path. LXD formats it; it must not be mounted. The pool keeps this device for its whole life. |
| `lxd_snap_channel` | str | `6/stable` | Snap channel of LXD. Changing it refreshes LXD in place; there is no way back. |
| `lxd_bridge_name` | str | `br-ext6` | Name of the host bridge of the external network. |
| `lxd_bridge_mtu` | int | `1500` | MTU of that bridge. |
| `lxd_project_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_project_name }}` | The LXD project. |
| `lxd_storage_pool_name` | str | `capi-fast` | Name of the btrfs pool of the node root disks. |
| `lxd_network_name` | str | `capi-int` | Name of the internal LXD bridge network. |
| `lxd_network_ipv4_address` | str | `10.77.0.1/24` | Gateway address and prefix of the internal network, IPv4 (NAT, DHCP). |
| `lxd_network_ipv6_address` | str | `fd42:77:1::1/64` | Gateway address and prefix of the internal network, IPv6 (NAT, router advertisements). |
| `lxd_network_dhcp_expiry` | str | `168h` | IPv4 lease time on the internal network, e.g. 168h; node addresses outlive a host outage this long. |
| `lxd_listener_port` | int | `8443` | Port of the LXD API on the internal gateway address (CAPN's endpoint). |
| `lxd_enabled` | bool | `true` | Run the role at all. |
| `lxd_flow_control_snap` | bool | `true` | The snapd and lxd snaps, the refresh hold, the daemon readiness. |
| `lxd_flow_control_bridge` | bool | `true` | The external bridge and its uplink (systemd-networkd). |
| `lxd_flow_control_registry` | bool | `true` | The image registry of the node images. |
| `lxd_flow_control_project` | bool | `true` | The restricted project. |
| `lxd_flow_control_storage` | bool | `true` | The btrfs pool. |
| `lxd_flow_control_network` | bool | `true` | The internal network. |
| `lxd_flow_control_listener` | bool | `true` | The LXD API listener on the internal gateway address. |
| `lxd_flow_control_profiles` | bool | `true` | The node and bootstrap profiles. |

## management_cluster

mgmt-1 through Helm on the API that currently manages it. Installs the ClusterClass and Cluster releases, writes mgmt.kubeconfig on host and runner, installs Calico and MetalLB with their gates (Gate B, Gate A) and writes handoff.json. Run the `state` entry point first in the same play.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig_runner` | path | required | Published by the `state` entry point — runner path of the managing API; the role stops with a message without it. |
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_artifacts_dir` | path | required | Runner directory of the kubeconfigs and handoff.json (0600 files). |
| `k8s_lab_lxd_host_address` | str | required | The host as the runner reaches it (an IPv4 address or a name); the published API servers are on this address. |
| `k8s_lab_api_listen_address` | str | required | IPv4 address of the host the published API servers listen on; restrict it on a host with a public address. |
| `k8s_lab_management_cluster_name` | str | required | Name of the management cluster. |
| `k8s_lab_cluster_namespace` | str | required | Namespace of the Cluster API objects and the CAPN identity Secret. |
| `k8s_lab_kubernetes_version` | str | required | Kubernetes version of the management cluster; must have an image on the CAPN image server. |
| `k8s_lab_infrastructure_secret_name` | str | required | Name of the CAPN identity Secret. |
| `management_cluster_kubeconfig` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig_runner }}` | Runner kubeconfig of the API that holds the Cluster object. |
| `management_cluster_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Host directory with bin/ (kubectl) and etc/ (mgmt.kubeconfig, bootstrap.kubeconfig). |
| `management_cluster_artifacts_dir` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_artifacts_dir }}` | Runner directory of mgmt.kubeconfig, bootstrap.kubeconfig and handoff.json. |
| `management_cluster_api_host` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_lxd_host_address }}` | Host in the server URL of the runner-side mgmt.kubeconfig. |
| `management_cluster_api_listen_address` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_api_listen_address }}` | IPv4 address of the host mgmt-1's published API server listens on. |
| `management_cluster_handoff_path` | path | `{{ management_cluster_artifacts_dir }}/handoff.json` | Runner path of handoff.json, which Terraform roots read. |
| `management_cluster_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_management_cluster_name }}` | Name of the Cluster and prefix of its instances. |
| `management_cluster_namespace` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_cluster_namespace }}` | Namespace of the Cluster object. |
| `management_cluster_kubernetes_version` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_kubernetes_version }}` | Kubernetes version of the nodes. |
| `management_cluster_infrastructure_secret_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_infrastructure_secret_name }}` | The CAPN identity Secret the LXCCluster references. |
| `management_cluster_controlplane_count` | int | `1` | Control-plane nodes (odd, stacked etcd). |
| `management_cluster_worker_count` | int | `2` | Worker nodes (Gate B needs two). |
| `management_cluster_pod_cidrs` | list of str | `["10.244.0.0/16", "fd42:77:2::/56"]` | Pod networks as [IPv4, IPv6]. |
| `management_cluster_service_cidrs` | list of str | `["10.96.0.0/16", "fd42:77:3::/112"]` | Service networks as [IPv4, IPv6]. |
| `management_cluster_external_ipv6_prefix` | str | required | The external IPv6 network of the nodes' eth1, `<prefix>/<length>`; NodePorts answer only there. |
| `management_cluster_metallb_vip_range_v6` | str | required | IPv6 VIP range on the external network, `<first>-<last>`. |
| `management_cluster_class_timeout` | str | `5m` | Helm timeout of the ClusterClass release. |
| `management_cluster_cluster_timeout` | str | `50m` | Helm timeout of the Cluster release (waits for its hook, which publishes the API server). |
| `management_cluster_addons_timeout` | str | `10m` | Helm timeout of the add-on releases. |
| `management_cluster_cluster_test_timeout` | str | `35m` | Timeout of the Cluster release test. |
| `management_cluster_gates_timeout` | str | `15m` | Timeout of the Gate A and Gate B chart tests. |
| `management_cluster_enabled` | bool | `true` | Run the role at all. |
| `management_cluster_flow_control_cluster` | bool | `true` | ClusterClass and Cluster releases. |
| `management_cluster_flow_control_kubeconfig` | bool | `true` | mgmt.kubeconfig on host and runner. |
| `management_cluster_flow_control_addons` | bool | `true` | Calico and MetalLB. |
| `management_cluster_flow_control_gates` | bool | `true` | Gate B and Gate A. |
| `management_cluster_flow_control_handoff` | bool | `true` | handoff.json. |

### Entry point `state`

Which API manages mgmt-1, published as facts. Sets k8s_lab_management_state (absent, bootstrapping, self_hosted), k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig and k8s_lab_management_kubeconfig_runner. Refuses when instances of the cluster exist without a reachable managing API.

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `k8s_lab_opt_root` | path | required | Host directory for pinned binaries (bin/) and role state (etc/). |
| `k8s_lab_artifacts_dir` | path | required | Runner directory of the kubeconfigs and handoff.json (0600 files). |
| `k8s_lab_management_cluster_name` | str | required | Name of the management cluster. |
| `k8s_lab_cluster_namespace` | str | required | Namespace of the Cluster API objects and the CAPN identity Secret. |
| `k8s_lab_project_name` | str | required | LXD project every cluster instance lives in. |
| `k8s_lab_bootstrap_instance_name` | str | required | LXD instance of the bootstrap cluster. |
| `management_cluster_opt_root` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_opt_root }}` | Host directory with bin/ (kubectl) and etc/ (mgmt.kubeconfig, bootstrap.kubeconfig). |
| `management_cluster_artifacts_dir` | path | `{{ k8s_lab_artifacts_dir }}` | Runner directory of mgmt.kubeconfig, bootstrap.kubeconfig and handoff.json. |
| `management_cluster_name` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_management_cluster_name }}` | Name of the Cluster and prefix of its instances. |
| `management_cluster_namespace` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_cluster_namespace }}` | Namespace of the Cluster object. |
| `management_cluster_lxd_project` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_project_name }}` | LXD project of the instances. |
| `management_cluster_bootstrap_instance` | str | `{{ k8s_lab_bootstrap_instance_name }}` | Name of the bootstrap instance. |
